razonamiento: The diagram illustrates Versent's automated migration factory architecture from on-premises to AWS. Agents (AWS Application Discovery Service and CloudEndure) run on the on-premises servers to gather connection/utilization metadata and perform continuous block replication to an EC2 hot replica. The migration team kicks off the migration via Slack, which stores operational metadata in DynamoDB and triggers an EC2 Migration Factory instance. The factory queries Application Discovery Service, tells CloudEndure to stop replication, creates (bakes) an AMI, shares the encrypted AMI to the target account, and launches the target EC2 instance with proper sizing, IP, and tags.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Stores operational metadata, RTO/RPO, tags, target account, IP

nodes.name: EC2 (Migration Factory)
nodes.notes: Orchestrates discovery, replication cutoff, AMI creation, sharing, and deployment

nodes.name: APP DISCOVERY SERVICE
nodes.notes: Collects inbound/outbound TCP connections and utilization data

nodes.name: BAKE AMI
nodes.notes: Bakes AMI from replicated hot instance

nodes.name: SHARED AMI
nodes.notes: Encrypted AMI shared to target account

nodes.name: EC2 (Target Account)
nodes.notes: Final provisioned instance in target account

edges.respaldo: Drawn line from ON-PREM to APP DISCOVERY SERVICE; 'Application discovery service is installed the on-premises server. This really gives us the inbound and outbound TCP connections.'
Drawn line from ON-PREM to EC2 HOT REPLICA; 'CloudEndure live migration agent... it's block by block replication from the on-premises server to AWS.'
Drawn arrow from CLOUDENURE to EC2 HOT REPLICA.
Drawn arrow from MIGRATION TEAM to SLACK; 'It's kicked off from Slack. So the migration team will issue one command.'
Drawn arrow branching from SLACK downward path to DYNAMODB; 'migration team filling DynamoDB with actually metadata.'
Drawn arrow branching to EC2; 'That then effectively talks to the EC2 instance... calls the API on the EC2 instance.'
Drawn arrow from EC2 to APP DISCOVERY SERVICE; 'EC2 instance will talk to the application discovery service to gather the TCB inbound and outbound connections.'
Drawn arrow from EC2 to CLOUDENURE; 'It will also talk to CloudEndure... CloudEndure will then effectively stop the replication.'
Drawn arrow from EC2 to BAKE AMI; 'EC2 instance, or the migration factory, will then bake the AMI.'

edges.notes: Shares encrypted AMI to target account
edges.respaldo: Drawn arrow from EC2 crossing dotted line to SHARED AMI; 'share that AMI across to the target account... using the metadata that lives in DynamoDB.'

edges.notes: Starts target EC2 instance with metadata
edges.respaldo: Drawn arrow from EC2 crossing dotted line to target EC2; 'We then start that instance. And at that point, you're applying all of your sizing and your firewall rules.'
